justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr, BinOp, UnaryOp, Value, and EvalError variants, though TypeError carries a String message rather than a structured variant distinguishing operand/operator details.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums with distinguishing variants and consistent Result usage; uses wrapping arithmetic and a couple of unreachable!/unwrap calls (on UTF-8 slices and exhaustive matches) without documenting their safety reasoning.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean narrow surface with Display/Debug on errors and module-level docs, but most public items (Expr, Value, BinOp, UnaryOp, parse, eval, ParseError fields) lack doc comments.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, matches!, derives, and clean recursive descent, though the env uses a Vec of (String, Value) with linear scan and some clones rather than borrowed slices or a more idiomatic scope structure.
